Hello all!

I am new to this List Server, and have received several e-mails

Marine Studies Program,
University of the South Pacific,
Suva, Fiji Islands.

> > I am new to this List Server, and have received several e-mails
> > which refer to the use of a text book. Could you please direct me
> > on how to obtain a copy of this book.

I'll copy this to the list, as there may be others out there
similarly puzzled over the references. The book is
out of print, so we have put it on our web pages, where it can be
downloaded for free. You'll find a link through from the RUWPA page
below. We have also printed our own copies of the book, which can be
ordered from us - this information is also on our web pages.
